resources.string: Explore the same task list built with two Android architectures. Toggle tasks, refresh, and try error recovery to compare their behavior.
MVVM (Model–View–ViewModel): the UI calls ViewModel methods, which load data and update the screen state.
MVI (Model–View–Intent): the UI sends explicit intents. A processor handles them, and a reducer turns results into screen state.
Both examples use a ViewModel and one state stream. The difference here is how actions and state transitions are organized.
